newsitem.title: SWEDEN: ABB to lead $360 mln Turkey power project.
newsitem.headline: ABB to lead $360 mln Turkey power project.

text.p: International electrical engineering company ABB AG on Thursday said its Turkish unit had won a contract to build a gas fired power station in Turkey.
The total order is worth $360 million, and ABB's share of the order represents $320 million.
The order was placed by the private power producer Uni-Mar Enerji Yatirimlari AS in Ankara.
Uni-Mars is owned by Marubeni Corp of Tokyo and Belgium's Unit International SA, ABB said in a statement.
The project will be carried out on a build, operate and transfer basis with the 480 MW power station expected to be ready for production by the summer of 1998.
The power station, located 100 kms west of Istanbul at Marmara-Ereglisi, will be operated by Britain's National Power Plc.
